newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-LEVERKUSEN SIGN BRAZILIAN EMERSON FROM GREMIO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LEVERKUSEN SIGN BRAZILIAN EMERSON FROM GREMIO.

text.p: Bayer Leverkusen on Thursday signed midfielder Emerson from Gremio of Brazil to replace compatriot Paulo Sergio, who is joining Roma.
Media reports put the transfer fee for the 21-year-old new arrival at eight million marks ($4.7 million). He is not connected with the Emerson who plays for Middlesbrough in England.
Leverkusen, last season's Bundesliga runners-up, will receive seven million marks ($4 million) for Sergio's move to the Italian club.

Leverkusen general manager Reiner Calmund said the club also hoped to sign another Brazilian player in the next few days and was confident he would secure the services of Czech midfielder Martin Frydek from Sparta Pargue.
"There are a few small matters still to be cleared up. We'll take care of those," Calmund said.
